findings.result: Asynchronous/event-driven utility scope, callback registration/event gathering, loop usually forever and pseudocode retained. File-write/socket-read/timer events, uv_run central role, blocking I/O waiting/performance explanation, standard thread alternative retained.

OS socket watch/event queue/inspect-and-fetch narrative, async interest-vs-later data use, nonblocking freedom for other work retained. Throughput explanation keeps original hardware-capacity footnote. Background threads/workers and/or polling note retains usually, not universal guarantee.

Author introduction and original YouTube-nocookie embedded element retained, fixed design-doc link retained. Footer distinguishes external supplementary media from Libx CC BY4.0 document licence; no video copy/relicensing. Full external video viewing/semantic/audio review NOT performed and not counted as a reviewed fixed textual source.

All original examples retained. Immediate exit without events, API watchers required, v1.0 allocate-before-init/custom memory management and close-then-release advice retained. Default loop one-loop recommendation and node.js binding note retained.

Original prose says examples never close loops but helloworld/default-loop/idle-basic fixed sources all call uv_loop_close. Literal source is not silently corrected; EN/JA footer identifies discrepancy with all3source links. Primary source hashes and repeatable overlay confirm this.
Possibly-failing init/sync negative returns vs async callback status retained. UV_E* constants, strerror message vs err_name name/const char*, nread<0 and special EOF handling retained.

Opaque uv_TYPE_t usage, long-lived handles vs short-lived requests usually one callback/I/O and context preservation retained. UDP socket uv_udp_t vs individual send uv_udp_send_t distinguished. Full typedef list and init prototype copied without amendments.

Application callbacks/data/timer examples retained. Idle callback once per turn, watcher lifecycle, uv_run waiting until no active watchers and stop at count retained. This is blocking of the call, not a claim that active idle blocks the I/O poll. data member opaque void* and casting context back, including loop data, retained.

6literal blocks including English pseudocode and code comments deliberately preserved exactly. Captions, headings, all narrative and footnote translated consistently. Libx notes stay only in footer; author content and licensing remain separate.
